messages:
Infra Bot: live now 1 polaris-ams2 hotpool is online in AMS2. Initial size: 18 instances. Flavor: Polaris-L (low-latency gen). Tags: #dedicated #polaris #ams2 :rocket:
Nora H: quick note: Polaris is tuned for low-latency interactive chat and high-QPS embeddings. Expect ~10-18% lower p50 vs baseline.
Vikram S: reservation model: 40% reserved / 60% burst for soft-open. Reserve via Console or CLI. CLI example:
```
redwood reserve --pool polaris-ams2 --count 2 --duration 30d --commit monthly --tags team=chat
```
Product Ops: billing: new SKU dedicated.polaris effective now. Metering per-instance-minute. Intro: teams that migrate a prod route within 30 days get a 3% credit.
Infra Oncall: ops note: burst instances may be reclaimed during planned maintenance. Reserved commits are non-preemptible. We'll post the maintenance calendar in #infra-maintenance.
Vikram S: routing: default will prefer polaris-ams2 for routes with region preference ams2. Fallback chain: polaris-ams2-compat -> ams1-standard -> europe-h100. Strict routing toggle available in Console.
Nora H: model_profile options: polaris-default and polaris-high-qps (smaller batch sizes). Quantization: 8-bit supported. If you hit quality diffs, file an eval with Optimize and reference polaris-ams2.
Infra Bot: docs: https://intra.redwood.dev/dedicated/polaris-ams2 (internal). Pool ID polaris-ams2-002.
Product Ops: rollout plan: day 0 soft-open (this), day 5 expand burst to 36 instances if health is good, day 14 enable annual commit UI.
Infra Oncall: health checks running; expect short warmup spikes in telemetry. Escalate on >8% error or >25% p95 regression. :mag:
